source: Project-authored empirical combination of the existing RC reservoir and independent pressure contours
qualification: Unqualified teaching source preserving legacy contour appearance; no valve/reflection dynamics, independent right-heart source, wedge-pressure model, CVP mean response or pressure numerics

model.reservoir: VascularPressureRcIllustration@1, unchanged input intensity, duration and decay kernel
model.reference_excess_within_cycle: Sref(u) = max(S0, S0 * a(u) + E * g * k_D(u)); g is the selected beat gain (1 by default), D its ejection duration; premature illustration@4 fixes the previously unweighted reference input
model.desired_contour: M(t) = S0 + sum of active beat-weighted finite LUT pulses; latest effective ejection selects reference
model.support: Reference lasts one minimum effective interval; each contour retains its own full support across later events. MaximumPulseOverlap defaults1, allowed1..8, reserves ceil(duration/min effective interval) pulse heights. Duration must fit bounded RC history. Beyond reference support use S0, preserving active tails.
model.gates: Shared ventricular mechanical selection, including activity, conduction, suppression, resumption and original-index stride
model.bounds: Reference onset excess >= 1 centi-mmHg; conservative full-output int16 amplitude budget including 1 centi-mmHg rounding reserve validated before generation
model.arithmetic: Integer-ns timing, Q32.32 pressure, Q2.62 decay, Int128 intermediates, nearest ties to even
model.compatibility: Absent or null Morphology retains the exact raw RC evaluation path

verification: Independent original-LUT contour comparison at periodic reference
Default and first resumed ABP/PA peak, notch and rebound landmarks
No pulses during mechanical absence, continuous runoff and re-entry
Batching, checkpoint replay, pending-sample tampering and invalid configuration
